text:
deploy-bot: AUTO: Canary policy triggered for rollout v3.4.0 -> p95 latency 2140ms over 5m. Holding further traffic and opening thread. Suggested actions: graceful drain, pin old variant, or automatic rollback to v3.3.2. Please ack and pick action.

maria: ack. seeing same in eu-west-1 and us-west-2. logs show increased KV cache misses after kqueue change.

aj: +1. can we try a graceful drain to 0 for the canary slice first? give us 5m to validate.

beth: ops: graceful drain ok, but we need to update release notes + customer comms if we pin. who owns that?

kevin: i can draft a one-paragraph customer note. if we revert, we should include ETA and affected endpoints.

jason_pm: keep marketing/customer comms minimal — only notify if we pin or rollback. PM prefers try drain -> monitor -> rollback if regression persists.

maria: executing graceful drain now: `rolloutctl drain --slice canary --timeout 300s --wait`

ops-bot: COMMAND EXECUTED by maria: `rolloutctl drain --slice canary --timeout 300s --wait`

aj: watching p95. initial 30% -> 10% traffic, latency dropped to ~1.1s within 90s. good sign.

maria: still seeing error rate from one instance group (ig-5a). pulling logs. `kubectl logs --tail=200 ig-5a -c runtime`

beth: if ig-5a is unhealthy we should consider pinning users on dedicated pools for the affected tenants. but that's heavier.

kevin: draft attached: "We're pausing the canary while we investigate elevated latency. No customer-facing impact expected; we'll update if we need to revert or extend the maintenance window."

aj: quick check: deploybot auto-rollback threshold is p95 > 2s for 10m or error-rate > 3% for 5m, right?

deploy-bot: CONFIG: canary_auto_rollback.p95_threshold=2000ms, p95_window=600s, error_rate_threshold=0.03, error_window=300s. Current p95 breach is 5m only. not yet hitting auto-rollback window.

maria: decision: keep hold + drain. Ops to triage ig-5a. If we see repeated p95 >2s at 10m, we will trigger manual rollback to v3.3.2.

jason_pm: please create release-note entry so support can reference it if customers ask. tag me when done.

kevin: created draft in docs repo and pinged #support-daily. link: https://go/release-notes/2912-draft

aj: triage update: ig-5a OOMs on worker due to new attention cache config. reproducing in staging now. root cause looks like config mismatch during rolling update.

maria: reconfigure KV cache flags on ig-5a to match canary baseline, rolling restart. `kops update ig ig-5a --set env.RUNTIME_KV_CACHE=legacy && kubectl rollout restart nodegroup/ig-5a`

ops-bot: SUGGESTION: consider pinning production traffic to v3.3.2 for affected tenants using routing policy `route:pin(customer_tier=enterprise, version=3.3.2)` while we fix.

beth: manual pinning is last resort. it requires CS notification and SLA check. only do if latency/error doesn't improve after 20m.

aj: staging repro confirms fix. rolling restart of ig-5a looks healthy so far.

maria: monitoring: p95 back to ~900ms across regions. error-rate normal. i'm lifting the hold and resuming rollout slowly.

deploy-bot: ACTION: rollout resumed to 40% -> continuing auto-increase per policy. No auto-rollback triggered.

jason_pm: thanks team. postmortem notes: 1) ensure attention cache config is part of upgrade preflight, 2) add a short section in release notes about the canary hold and outcome.

kevin: added postmortem bullet to draft, will convert to short customer-facing blurb if needed.

beth: closing checklist: update runbook with `--timeout` guidance for drains, add probe to detect KV mismatch, and mark ig-5a as flapped for oncall context.

maria: done. patch in the runbook repo: https://go/runbooks/rollouts#graceful-drain-updates

aj: nothing else from me. good drill. :thumbsup:

kevin: leaving note for support: "Canary paused due to latency spike, graceful drain executed, underlying nodegroup config patched, rollout resumed."

deploy-bot: THREAD CLOSED: Rollout resumed. No rollback executed. If metrics regress to breach thresholds, this thread will reopen automatically.
